notes.title: Obby - Best game you're bad at
notes.content: The Steam Awards are coming up. This year, Kitty is hoping for her vote for "Best Game You're Bad At." Kitty is the perfect choice because the sooner you get upset about not getting anywhere, the better Obby fits into this category. So if you're already upset, vote for us so that everyone knows how hard it can be to jump from stone to stone. Thank you for your vote.
